exposure: International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG) diagnostic criteria for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM)
cohort: 286 women with GDM diagnosed and followed at a single university center (129 women diagnosed in 2009-2010 and 157 women diagnosed in 2012-2013)
finding: The adoption of IADPSG criteria for GDM diagnosis led to a lower need for insulin therapy but did not significantly affect other maternal or neonatal outcomes except for a decrease in neonatal hypoglycemia.
